name: sapisehat
description: SapiSehat monorepo — cattle disease detection app

scripts.backend:dev: cd apps/backend && docker compose down -v && docker compose up --build -d
scripts.backend:test: cd apps/backend && docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/ -v
scripts.mobile:deploy: cd apps/mobile && .\gradlew assembleDebug && cd ../.. && node scripts/run-adb.mjs install -r apps/mobile/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
scripts.mobile:run: cd apps/mobile && .\gradlew assembleDebug && cd ../.. && node scripts/run-adb.mjs install -r apps/mobile/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && node scripts/run-adb.mjs shell am start -n com.sapisehat.app/.MainActivity
scripts.mobile:restart: node scripts/run-adb.mjs shell am force-stop com.sapisehat.app && node scripts/run-adb.mjs shell am start -n com.sapisehat.app/.MainActivity
scripts.build: pnpm run backend:build && pnpm run dashboard:build
